13/S0.subgoal: Introduce the hardware components used for the VR experience.

13/S1.subgoal: Describe the components of a complete VR system and the interaction between hardware, the user, and the physical environment.

13/S2.subgoal: Identify the three major categories of VR hardware: displays, sensors, and processing units.

13/S3.subgoal: Describe various types of hand-based input mechanisms, including world-grounded, non-tracked, and hand-worn devices.

13/S4.subgoal: Explain how bare hand inputs work using computer vision techniques.

13/S5.subgoal: Explain non-hand-based input devices such as head tracking and eye tracking, including the Midas touch problem.

13/S6.subgoal: Summarize the major components of VR hardware and preview the next part of the lecture.
